decision: Directory attribution only for two AudioStack configured roots and one Nativo configured root. No endpoint contract or vendor rulepack is added.
privacy: Sources are public first-party pages. Tests use synthetic paths and values. Captured customer URLs and opaque names are excluded.

entries.source_location: Section 12, VAST Ad Serving and Tracking
entries.supported_claim: AudioStack explicitly identifies these service hosts and names Aflorithmic Labs LTD as operator.
entries.unsupported_claim: No collector path, query requiredness, value grammar, signature verification or delivery guarantee is established.

entries.source_location: Example ad-serving responses and tracking URLs
entries.supported_claim: Nativo publishes jadserve.postrelease.com as its serving and tracking host.
entries.unsupported_claim: Native examples do not establish private VAST ntv_* requiredness, event enums, ID grammar or ord constraints.

matching_scope: The configured roots use the existing directory rule: exact root and child subdomains. Parent domains, lookalikes and staging-* siblings are not configured. No global matcher behavior changes.
coverage: recognized_uncontracted with core checks. No vendor_checked gain.
